alt: Paired SL and HL bars: number and algebra 16 and 29, functions 31 and 42, geometry and trigonometry 18 and 46, statistics and probability 36 and 52, calculus 19 and 41. The strands total 120 hours at SL and 210 at HL, plus 30 hours of toolkit and exploration at both levels.
caption: Statistics leads at both levels; at HL geometry and trigonometry overtakes functions.

alt: Paper 1, short-response questions, is worth 40% at SL and 30% at HL; Paper 2, extended-response questions, 40% and 30%; Paper 3, HL only, 20%; and the exploration, the internal assessment, 20% at both levels. Technology is allowed throughout every paper.
caption: Every paper allows technology, so practise with your own calculator all course.

after: ## Toolkit and exploration (30 hours, both SL and HL)
alt: The 30 hours at both levels are shared between the toolkit and the exploration, which takes up to 15 hours. The toolkit builds inquiry, modelling and technology skills; the exploration is a compulsory internally assessed investigation worth 20%. Six assessment objectives apply across all strands.
caption: Up to half of the 30 hours goes on the exploration itself.
